name: Luck & Magic

features.name: Card reels
features.description: Face-down cards flip over instead of reels spinning.

features.name: Pick a card bonus
features.description: Choose one of five cards to reveal your multiplier.

review:
No spinning reels here – face-down cards flip over after each spin, like a magician deciding your fate. Five lines.

In the bonus you pick one of five face-down cards. The others flip first, then yours reveals the multiplier applied to your bet. One of BGaming's most unusual presentations, even if the maths is close to its other 3x3 bonus games. Very high volatility, 1,059x max, 96.23% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
